title: ActorSubjectLinkStatusRecord
description: AAB-PLATFORM-04 ActorSubjectLinkStatusRecord: SUSPEND, REINSTATE or REVOKE, written once against a link and never changed. Signed by the named human who writes it, never the linked actor.

statementSignature.description: Ed25519 signature over the statement's canonical JSON: 64 bytes, standard base64.

writtenBy.description: HUMAN, with accountableName; never the linked actor.

recordDigest.description: "sha256:" and the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of every other field of the record.
